# U62: Settings is about you: Your page opens your person page; no Make button for tokens; one recording line that leads to Privacy; Leave at the foot asks who takes over; the only admin is told why not; Workspace has no Leave

- **Belongs to:** the AI access module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `LEAVE-WORKSPACE`, `SETTINGS`
- **Budget:** at most 6 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/settings` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 4217

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/settings` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Your page” link is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if Settings offers to make a token, or its recording line does not lead to Privacy.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “settings”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Your page” link.
- **Check:** The “Rhea Kapoor” heading shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) the address matches “/people/rhea” (else: Your page opened {p.url()}).
- Go to `/settings` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Leave this workspace…” button.
- **Check:** The “Leave …Platform Engineering” dialog shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if leaving does not ask who takes over.
- Press the Escape key.
- Go to `/workspace` in the demo.
- **Check:** The workspace facts shows.
- **Check:** (`errors`) the “Leave this workspace” button is not there (else: Workspace still has Leave).
- _Note:_ The only admin sees why not.
- Go to `/settings` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “Leave this workspace…” button shows.
- **Check:** (`logged`) the “Leave this workspace…” button is disabled and the words “You’re the only admin. Make someone else an admin first” is visible (else: the only admin is not told why they can’t leave).
- Close this browser.
